        Idea:
Implement an opt-in Duplicate with videos flow for shot duplication. Existing duplicate buttons must remain image-only. Add a small hover affordance on the duplicate-shot buttons in both the shots panel and travel-between-images shot list; hovering that affordance should show Duplicate with videos. The with-videos path must create an independent cloned graph: duplicate the shot, duplicate positioned image generations as current behavior expects if needed, duplicate parent/final video generations and all child segment generations, remap parent_generation_id and pair_shot_generation_id relationships to the cloned shot_generation/image slots, preserve relevant generation fields, variants, thumbnails, locations, params, metadata, ordering, and final video behavior, and invalidate the relevant shots/final-video/segment caches. Do not physically copy storage objects unless the plan decides it is necessary; row-level independence is required, meaning copied videos and segments must not share generation IDs with the source. Include focused tests/migrations for the RPC and frontend behavior.

User notes and answers:
- Decision answers for plan questions: (1) For the with-videos path, clone parent/final video generations and child segment generations into new generation IDs. Keep positioned image generation rows shared like the existing duplicate behavior, but create new shot_generations rows for the cloned shot so pair_shot_generation_id can remap to cloned slots. (2) Set based_on on cloned generation rows to the source generation ID as provenance unless an existing local convention requires preserving it differently; do not leave cloned video/segment rows pointing relationship fields at the old graph. (3) Use new created_at timestamps for cloned rows, while preserving explicit ordering/position fields such as timeline_frame, metadata, child_order, shot position, and variant primary/ordering semantics.
- Revision direction: stop relying only on an enumerated JSON path list. The RPC implementation should include a focused SQL JSONB remap helper for cloned video/segment params that recursively rewrites known relationship keys wherever they occur in nested objects: shot_id source->new shot, parent_generation_id source parent video->cloned parent video, pair_shot_generation_id source shot_generation->cloned shot_generation, pair_shot_generation_ids arrays source shot_generation IDs->cloned shot_generation IDs. It must explicitly preserve shared image generation ID arrays such as input_image_generation_ids unless a value is in the cloned video/segment generation map. The SQL fixture/assertions must include originalParams.orchestrator_details.shot_id and fail if any known relationship path still references source shot/parent/pair IDs after cloning.
- Revision direction: The graph-clone remap contract must cover generation params and generation_variants.params identically. Cloned variant params must be passed through the same recursive JSONB helper before insertion so primary-variant sync triggers cannot reintroduce source IDs. Add child_generation_id to the relationship key set and remap source child segment generation IDs to cloned child segment generation IDs wherever the key occurs. SQL tests must include variant params containing source shot_id, parent_generation_id, pair_shot_generation_id(s), and child_generation_id, and assert cloned generation params and cloned primary variant params contain cloned IDs or preserved shared image generation IDs as appropriate.

        Idea:
Implement an opt-in Duplicate with videos flow for shot duplication. Existing duplicate buttons must remain image-only. Add a small hover affordance on the duplicate-shot buttons in both the shots panel and travel-between-images shot list; hovering that affordance should show Duplicate with videos. The with-videos path must create an independent cloned graph: duplicate the shot, duplicate positioned image generations as current behavior expects if needed, duplicate parent/final video generations and all child segment generations, remap parent_generation_id and pair_shot_generation_id relationships to the cloned shot_generation/image slots, preserve relevant generation fields, variants, thumbnails, locations, params, metadata, ordering, and final video behavior, and invalidate the relevant shots/final-video/segment caches. Do not physically copy storage objects unless the plan decides it is necessary; row-level independence is required, meaning copied videos and segments must not share generation IDs with the source. Include focused tests/migrations for the RPC and frontend behavior.

User notes and answers:
- Decision answers for plan questions: (1) For the with-videos path, clone parent/final video generations and child segment generations into new generation IDs. Keep positioned image generation rows shared like the existing duplicate behavior, but create new shot_generations rows for the cloned shot so pair_shot_generation_id can remap to cloned slots. (2) Set based_on on cloned generation rows to the source generation ID as provenance unless an existing local convention requires preserving it differently; do not leave cloned video/segment rows pointing relationship fields at the old graph. (3) Use new created_at timestamps for cloned rows, while preserving explicit ordering/position fields such as timeline_frame, metadata, child_order, shot position, and variant primary/ordering semantics.
- Revision direction: stop relying only on an enumerated JSON path list. The RPC implementation should include a focused SQL JSONB remap helper for cloned video/segment params that recursively rewrites known relationship keys wherever they occur in nested objects: shot_id source->new shot, parent_generation_id source parent video->cloned parent video, pair_shot_generation_id source shot_generation->cloned shot_generation, pair_shot_generation_ids arrays source shot_generation IDs->cloned shot_generation IDs. It must explicitly preserve shared image generation ID arrays such as input_image_generation_ids unless a value is in the cloned video/segment generation map. The SQL fixture/assertions must include originalParams.orchestrator_details.shot_id and fail if any known relationship path still references source shot/parent/pair IDs after cloning.
- Revision direction: The graph-clone remap contract must cover generation params and generation_variants.params identically. Cloned variant params must be passed through the same recursive JSONB helper before insertion so primary-variant sync triggers cannot reintroduce source IDs. Add child_generation_id to the relationship key set and remap source child segment generation IDs to cloned child segment generation IDs wherever the key occurs. SQL tests must include variant params containing source shot_id, parent_generation_id, pair_shot_generation_id(s), and child_generation_id, and assert cloned generation params and cloned primary variant params contain cloned IDs or preserved shared image generation IDs as appropriate.

Implement an opt-in Duplicate with videos flow for shot duplication. Existing duplicate buttons must remain image-only. Add a small hover affordance on the duplicate-shot buttons in both the shots panel and travel-between-images shot list; hovering that affordance should show Duplicate with videos. The with-videos path must create an independent cloned graph: duplicate the shot, duplicate positioned image generations as current behavior expects if needed, duplicate parent/final video generations and all child segment generations, remap parent_generation_id and pair_shot_generation_id relationships to the cloned shot_generation/image slots, preserve relevant generation fields, variants, thumbnails, locations, params, metadata, ordering, and final video behavior, and invalidate the relevant shots/final-video/segment caches. Do not physically copy storage objects unless the plan decides it is necessary; row-level independence is required, meaning copied videos and segments must not share generation IDs with the source. Include focused tests/migrations for the RPC and frontend behavior.

Keep positioned image generation rows shared like the existing duplicate behavior, but create new shot_generations rows for the cloned shot so pair_shot_generation_id can remap to cloned slots. (2) Set based_on on cloned generation rows to the source generation ID as provenance unless an existing local convention requires preserving it differently; do not leave cloned video/segment rows pointing relationship fields at the old graph. It must explicitly preserve shared image generation ID arrays such as input_image_generation_ids unless a value is in the cloned video/segment generation map. The SQL fixture/assertions must include originalParams.orchestrator_details.shot_id and fail if any known relationship path still references source shot/parent/pair IDs after cloning.

        Idea:
Implement an opt-in Duplicate with videos flow for shot duplication. Existing duplicate buttons must remain image-only. Add a small hover affordance on the duplicate-shot buttons in both the shots panel and travel-between-images shot list; hovering that affordance should show Duplicate with videos. The with-videos path must create an independent cloned graph: duplicate the shot, duplicate positioned image generations as current behavior expects if needed, duplicate parent/final video generations and all child segment generations, remap parent_generation_id and pair_shot_generation_id relationships to the cloned shot_generation/image slots, preserve relevant generation fields, variants, thumbnails, locations, params, metadata, ordering, and final video behavior, and invalidate the relevant shots/final-video/segment caches. Do not physically copy storage objects unless the plan decides it is necessary; row-level independence is required, meaning copied videos and segments must not share generation IDs with the source. Include focused tests/migrations for the RPC and frontend behavior.

User notes and answers:
- Decision answers for plan questions: (1) For the with-videos path, clone parent/final video generations and child segment generations into new generation IDs. Keep positioned image generation rows shared like the existing duplicate behavior, but create new shot_generations rows for the cloned shot so pair_shot_generation_id can remap to cloned slots. (2) Set based_on on cloned generation rows to the source generation ID as provenance unless an existing local convention requires preserving it differently; do not leave cloned video/segment rows pointing relationship fields at the old graph. (3) Use new created_at timestamps for cloned rows, while preserving explicit ordering/position fields such as timeline_frame, metadata, child_order, shot position, and variant primary/ordering semantics.
- Revision direction: stop relying only on an enumerated JSON path list. The RPC implementation should include a focused SQL JSONB remap helper for cloned video/segment params that recursively rewrites known relationship keys wherever they occur in nested objects: shot_id source->new shot, parent_generation_id source parent video->cloned parent video, pair_shot_generation_id source shot_generation->cloned shot_generation, pair_shot_generation_ids arrays source shot_generation IDs->cloned shot_generation IDs. It must explicitly preserve shared image generation ID arrays such as input_image_generation_ids unless a value is in the cloned video/segment generation map. The SQL fixture/assertions must include originalParams.orchestrator_details.shot_id and fail if any known relationship path still references source shot/parent/pair IDs after cloning.
- Revision direction: The graph-clone remap contract must cover generation params and generation_variants.params identically. Cloned variant params must be passed through the same recursive JSONB helper before insertion so primary-variant sync triggers cannot reintroduce source IDs. Add child_generation_id to the relationship key set and remap source child segment generation IDs to cloned child segment generation IDs wherever the key occurs. SQL tests must include variant params containing source shot_id, parent_generation_id, pair_shot_generation_id(s), and child_generation_id, and assert cloned generation params and cloned primary variant params contain cloned IDs or preserved shared image generation IDs as appropriate.

Do not physically copy storage objects unless the plan decides it is necessary; row-level independence is required, meaning copied videos and segments must not share generation IDs with the source. Include focused tests/migrations for the RPC and frontend behavior.

        Idea:
Implement an opt-in Duplicate with videos flow for shot duplication. Existing duplicate buttons must remain image-only. Add a small hover affordance on the duplicate-shot buttons in both the shots panel and travel-between-images shot list; hovering that affordance should show Duplicate with videos. The with-videos path must create an independent cloned graph: duplicate the shot, duplicate positioned image generations as current behavior expects if needed, duplicate parent/final video generations and all child segment generations, remap parent_generation_id and pair_shot_generation_id relationships to the cloned shot_generation/image slots, preserve relevant generation fields, variants, thumbnails, locations, params, metadata, ordering, and final video behavior, and invalidate the relevant shots/final-video/segment caches. Do not physically copy storage objects unless the plan decides it is necessary; row-level independence is required, meaning copied videos and segments must not share generation IDs with the source. Include focused tests/migrations for the RPC and frontend behavior.

User notes and answers:
- Decision answers for plan questions: (1) For the with-videos path, clone parent/final video generations and child segment generations into new generation IDs. Keep positioned image generation rows shared like the existing duplicate behavior, but create new shot_generations rows for the cloned shot so pair_shot_generation_id can remap to cloned slots. (2) Set based_on on cloned generation rows to the source generation ID as provenance unless an existing local convention requires preserving it differently; do not leave cloned video/segment rows pointing relationship fields at the old graph. (3) Use new created_at timestamps for cloned rows, while preserving explicit ordering/position fields such as timeline_frame, metadata, child_order, shot position, and variant primary/ordering semantics.
- Revision direction: stop relying only on an enumerated JSON path list. The RPC implementation should include a focused SQL JSONB remap helper for cloned video/segment params that recursively rewrites known relationship keys wherever they occur in nested objects: shot_id source->new shot, parent_generation_id source parent video->cloned parent video, pair_shot_generation_id source shot_generation->cloned shot_generation, pair_shot_generation_ids arrays source shot_generation IDs->cloned shot_generation IDs. It must explicitly preserve shared image generation ID arrays such as input_image_generation_ids unless a value is in the cloned video/segment generation map. The SQL fixture/assertions must include originalParams.orchestrator_details.shot_id and fail if any known relationship path still references source shot/parent/pair IDs after cloning.
- Revision direction: The graph-clone remap contract must cover generation params and generation_variants.params identically. Cloned variant params must be passed through the same recursive JSONB helper before insertion so primary-variant sync triggers cannot reintroduce source IDs. Add child_generation_id to the relationship key set and remap source child segment generation IDs to cloned child segment generation IDs wherever the key occurs. SQL tests must include variant params containing source shot_id, parent_generation_id, pair_shot_generation_id(s), and child_generation_id, and assert cloned generation params and cloned primary variant params contain cloned IDs or preserved shared image generation IDs as appropriate.

        Idea:
Implement an opt-in Duplicate with videos flow for shot duplication. Existing duplicate buttons must remain image-only. Add a small hover affordance on the duplicate-shot buttons in both the shots panel and travel-between-images shot list; hovering that affordance should show Duplicate with videos. The with-videos path must create an independent cloned graph: duplicate the shot, duplicate positioned image generations as current behavior expects if needed, duplicate parent/final video generations and all child segment generations, remap parent_generation_id and pair_shot_generation_id relationships to the cloned shot_generation/image slots, preserve relevant generation fields, variants, thumbnails, locations, params, metadata, ordering, and final video behavior, and invalidate the relevant shots/final-video/segment caches. Do not physically copy storage objects unless the plan decides it is necessary; row-level independence is required, meaning copied videos and segments must not share generation IDs with the source. Include focused tests/migrations for the RPC and frontend behavior.

User notes and answers:
- Decision answers for plan questions: (1) For the with-videos path, clone parent/final video generations and child segment generations into new generation IDs. Keep positioned image generation rows shared like the existing duplicate behavior, but create new shot_generations rows for the cloned shot so pair_shot_generation_id can remap to cloned slots. (2) Set based_on on cloned generation rows to the source generation ID as provenance unless an existing local convention requires preserving it differently; do not leave cloned video/segment rows pointing relationship fields at the old graph. (3) Use new created_at timestamps for cloned rows, while preserving explicit ordering/position fields such as timeline_frame, metadata, child_order, shot position, and variant primary/ordering semantics.
- Revision direction: stop relying only on an enumerated JSON path list. The RPC implementation should include a focused SQL JSONB remap helper for cloned video/segment params that recursively rewrites known relationship keys wherever they occur in nested objects: shot_id source->new shot, parent_generation_id source parent video->cloned parent video, pair_shot_generation_id source shot_generation->cloned shot_generation, pair_shot_generation_ids arrays source shot_generation IDs->cloned shot_generation IDs. It must explicitly preserve shared image generation ID arrays such as input_image_generation_ids unless a value is in the cloned video/segment generation map. The SQL fixture/assertions must include originalParams.orchestrator_details.shot_id and fail if any known relationship path still references source shot/parent/pair IDs after cloning.
- Revision direction: The graph-clone remap contract must cover generation params and generation_variants.params identically. Cloned variant params must be passed through the same recursive JSONB helper before insertion so primary-variant sync triggers cannot reintroduce source IDs. Add child_generation_id to the relationship key set and remap source child segment generation IDs to cloned child segment generation IDs wherever the key occurs. SQL tests must include variant params containing source shot_id, parent_generation_id, pair_shot_generation_id(s), and child_generation_id, and assert cloned generation params and cloned primary variant params contain cloned IDs or preserved shared image generation IDs as appropriate.
- Revise the remaining verification tasks so review can proceed with documented limitations: SQL runtime test and throwaway SQL reproduction cannot execute in this sandbox because local DB/socket access is blocked; full npm run lint and full npm test fail on unrelated repo-wide debt.         Idea:
Implement an opt-in Duplicate with videos flow for shot duplication. Existing duplicate buttons must remain image-only. Add a small hover affordance on the duplicate-shot buttons in both the shots panel and travel-between-images shot list; hovering that affordance should show Duplicate with videos. The with-videos path must create an independent cloned graph: duplicate the shot, duplicate positioned image generations as current behavior expects if needed, duplicate parent/final video generations and all child segment generations, remap parent_generation_id and pair_shot_generation_id relationships to the cloned shot_generation/image slots, preserve relevant generation fields, variants, thumbnails, locations, params, metadata, ordering, and final video behavior, and invalidate the relevant shots/final-video/segment caches. Do not physically copy storage objects unless the plan decides it is necessary; row-level independence is required, meaning copied videos and segments must not share generation IDs with the source. Include focused tests/migrations for the RPC and frontend behavior.

User notes and answers:
- Decision answers for plan questions: (1) For the with-videos path, clone parent/final video generations and child segment generations into new generation IDs. Keep positioned image generation rows shared like the existing duplicate behavior, but create new shot_generations rows for the cloned shot so pair_shot_generation_id can remap to cloned slots. (2) Set based_on on cloned generation rows to the source generation ID as provenance unless an existing local convention requires preserving it differently; do not leave cloned video/segment rows pointing relationship fields at the old graph. (3) Use new created_at timestamps for cloned rows, while preserving explicit ordering/position fields such as timeline_frame, metadata, child_order, shot position, and variant primary/ordering semantics.
- Revision direction: stop relying only on an enumerated JSON path list. The RPC implementation should include a focused SQL JSONB remap helper for cloned video/segment params that recursively rewrites known relationship keys wherever they occur in nested objects: shot_id source->new shot, parent_generation_id source parent video->cloned parent video, pair_shot_generation_id source shot_generation->cloned shot_generation, pair_shot_generation_ids arrays source shot_generation IDs->cloned shot_generation IDs. It must explicitly preserve shared image generation ID arrays such as input_image_generation_ids unless a value is in the cloned video/segment generation map. The SQL fixture/assertions must include originalParams.orchestrator_details.shot_id and fail if any known relationship path still references source shot/parent/pair IDs after cloning.
- Revision direction: The graph-clone remap contract must cover generation params and generation_variants.params identically. Cloned variant params must be passed through the same recursive JSONB helper before insertion so primary-variant sync triggers cannot reintroduce source IDs. Add child_generation_id to the relationship key set and remap source child segment generation IDs to cloned child segment generation IDs wherever the key occurs. SQL tests must include variant params containing source shot_id, parent_generation_id, pair_shot_generation_id(s), and child_generation_id, and assert cloned generation params and cloned primary variant params contain cloned IDs or preserved shared image generation IDs as appropriate.
- Revise the remaining verification tasks so review can proceed with documented limitations: SQL runtime test and throwaway SQL reproduction cannot execute in this sandbox because local DB/socket access is blocked; full npm run lint and full npm test fail on unrelated repo-wide debt.         Idea:
Implement an opt-in Duplicate with videos flow for shot duplication. Existing duplicate buttons must remain image-only. Add a small hover affordance on the duplicate-shot buttons in both the shots panel and travel-between-images shot list; hovering that affordance should show Duplicate with videos. The with-videos path must create an independent cloned graph: duplicate the shot, duplicate positioned image generations as current behavior expects if needed, duplicate parent/final video generations and all child segment generations, remap parent_generation_id and pair_shot_generation_id relationships to the cloned shot_generation/image slots, preserve relevant generation fields, variants, thumbnails, locations, params, metadata, ordering, and final video behavior, and invalidate the relevant shots/final-video/segment caches. Do not physically copy storage objects unless the plan decides it is necessary; row-level independence is required, meaning copied videos and segments must not share generation IDs with the source. Include focused tests/migrations for the RPC and frontend behavior.

User notes and answers:
- Decision answers for plan questions: (1) For the with-videos path, clone parent/final video generations and child segment generations into new generation IDs. Keep positioned image generation rows shared like the existing duplicate behavior, but create new shot_generations rows for the cloned shot so pair_shot_generation_id can remap to cloned slots. (2) Set based_on on cloned generation rows to the source generation ID as provenance unless an existing local convention requires preserving it differently; do not leave cloned video/segment rows pointing relationship fields at the old graph. (3) Use new created_at timestamps for cloned rows, while preserving explicit ordering/position fields such as timeline_frame, metadata, child_order, shot position, and variant primary/ordering semantics.
- Revision direction: stop relying only on an enumerated JSON path list. The RPC implementation should include a focused SQL JSONB remap helper for cloned video/segment params that recursively rewrites known relationship keys wherever they occur in nested objects: shot_id source->new shot, parent_generation_id source parent video->cloned parent video, pair_shot_generation_id source shot_generation->cloned shot_generation, pair_shot_generation_ids arrays source shot_generation IDs->cloned shot_generation IDs. It must explicitly preserve shared image generation ID arrays such as input_image_generation_ids unless a value is in the cloned video/segment generation map. The SQL fixture/assertions must include originalParams.orchestrator_details.shot_id and fail if any known relationship path still references source shot/parent/pair IDs after cloning.
- Revision direction: The graph-clone remap contract must cover generation params and generation_variants.params identically. Cloned variant params must be passed through the same recursive JSONB helper before insertion so primary-variant sync triggers cannot reintroduce source IDs. Add child_generation_id to the relationship key set and remap source child segment generation IDs to cloned child segment generation IDs wherever the key occurs. SQL tests must include variant params containing source shot_id, parent_generation_id, pair_shot_generation_id(s), and child_generation_id, and assert cloned generation params and cloned primary variant params contain cloned IDs or preserved shared image generation IDs as appropriate.
- Revise the remaining verification tasks so review can proceed with documented limitations: SQL runtime test and throwaway SQL reproduction cannot execute in this sandbox because local DB/socket access is blocked; full npm run lint and full npm test fail on unrelated repo-wide debt. Feature-scoped tests pass and npx tsc --noEmit passes. Remaining review should judge the implemented feature against focused tests, static SQL fixture coverage, and the documented DB validation blocker.
